name: Pressroom
tagline: Risograph stencil prints — three spot inks on cream stock
technique: Risograph duplicator prints (Riso Kagaku 1986, indie print studios): flat overlapping spot inks, tone only through coarse halftone, slight misregistration, visible grain — no two copies identical.

plates.accept: Three inks only, flat shapes with halftone, misregistration visible; left half empty cream.
Hand + magnifier + chart, three inks, halftone; no text.
Paper stack + airplane, three inks, halftone; no text.
One row of same-height pictograms, evenly spaced; nothing else.
Blank cream stock only, even lighting.
One flat two-ink eye, halftone inside; pure white around it.
One flat two-ink hand; pure white around it.
One flat two-ink envelope with starburst; pure white around it.

generate.base: A risograph print in three spot inks — federal blue, sunflower yellow and bright green — on cream uncoated stock: {subject} drawn as flat overlapping ink shapes, tone only through coarse halftone dots, slight misregistration between the inks, visible print grain. Hands and objects only, never faces; no black outlines, no gradients.
generate.spot: A single risograph-printed pictogram of {subject}: flat federal blue shape with sunflower yellow accents, coarse halftone dots inside the shape for shading, slight misregistration between the two inks, soft ink edges, print grain inside the shape only.
generate.rules: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature anywhere in the image.

The hands and envelope occupy the right half; the left half is empty cream stock. No black outlines, no faces, no gradients.
